About this estimate

Coverage is modelled from ComReg’s licensed site locations, frequency bands and maximum EIRP, using terrain profiles, CORINE land-cover clutter and ITU-R P.1812-8 propagation. The receiver is 1.5 m above ground.

The stripes flag estimates within 10 dB of a colour cutoff. They show class sensitivity, not a statistical confidence interval.

  • Licence schedules do not give the active sector, antenna direction, downtilt or actual antenna height.
  • The model’s 48 dB link allowance is uncalibrated. The map is an indicative estimate, not measured handset coverage.
  • The national layer is sampled on an approximately 150 m ground grid. Terrain uses about 90 m pixels; land cover is from 2018.

Sources: ComReg mobile site schedules (Q1 2026), Natural Earth country boundary, Mapzen terrain tiles, CORINE Land Cover 2018 and ITU-R P.1812. Map tiles © OpenStreetMap contributors.
